name: wasd-movement
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Keyboard movement, Q/E camera turning and a spacebar attack, with per-device bindings and shortcut priority. Open Controls in game to configure or turn it off.

settings.label: Show the Controls button in game
settings.description: Hides the on-screen button. Movement, Q/E turning and the spacebar attack keep working with whatever is already configured, but the in-game Controls dialog is the only place to rebind keys, so turn this back on if you need to change them.
